@@ -3,6 +3,118 @@
 OpenCode Remote is a companion app that lets you control your OpenCode server from phone or desktop, even when you are not at your main workstation.
 It is designed to make daily usage simple: connect to your server, check active sessions, see progress, send new prompts or slash commands, and stop a running action when needed.
 
+---
+
+## 🤖 AI Harness / Machine-Readable Setup Guide
+
+This section provides structured, deterministic instructions for AI systems to configure OpenCode server and install/run the OpenCode Remote app.
+
+### Repository Metadata
+- **Repository**: `https://github.com/giuliastro/opencode-remote-android`
+- **Default Branch**: `main`
+- **License**: MIT
+- **Primary Language**: TypeScript (React)
+
+### Prerequisites (AI-Verifiable)
+| Requirement | Version | Check Command |
+|-------------|---------|---------------|
+| Node.js | >=18.0.0 | `node --version` |
+| npm | >=9.0.0 | `npm --version` |
+| OpenCode CLI | latest | `npx -y opencode-ai --version` |
+| Android SDK (for local APK) | API 34+ | `adb version` |
+
+### OpenCode Server Configuration (AI-Executable)
+
+**Environment Variables Required:**
+```bash
+OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME=opencode
+OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD=<secure-random-password>
+```
+
+**Server Start Command (cross-platform):**
+```bash
+npx -y opencode-ai serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096
+```
+
+**With CORS for Web Development:**
+```bash
+npx -y opencode-ai serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096 --cors http://localhost:5173 --cors http://127.0.0.1:5173
+```
+
+**Health Check Endpoint:** `GET http://<server-ip>:4096/global/health` (expects 200 OK)
+
+### App Installation & Build (AI-Executable)
+
+#### Option A: Download Pre-built APK (Recommended for AI)
+```bash
+# Latest release URL (AI can fetch programmatically)
+curl -L -o opencode-remote.apk "https://github.com/giuliastro/opencode-remote-android/releases/latest/download/app-release-signed.apk"
+```
+
+#### Option B: Build from Source (Web + Android)
+```bash
+# 1. Clone repository
+git clone https://github.com/giuliastro/opencode-remote-android.git
+cd opencode-remote-android
+
+# 2. Install web dependencies
+cd web && npm ci
+
+# 3. Build web app
+npm run build
+
+# 4. Initialize Capacitor Android (if not exists)
+npx cap add android
+
+# 5. Sync web assets to Android
+npx cap sync android
+
+# 6. Build release APK (requires Android SDK)
+cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
+# Output: web/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
+```
+
+#### Option C: Cloud Build via GitHub Actions (No Local SDK)
+- Push to `main` branch or trigger workflow `Build Android APK`
+- Download artifact `opencode-remote-release-apk-v<version>` from Actions
+
+### App Configuration (AI-Executable)
+
+**Required Settings (enter in app Settings screen):**
+| Field | Value | Example |
+|-------|-------|---------|
+| Host | Server LAN IP or hostname | `192.168.1.20` |
+| Port | `4096` | `4096` |
+| Username | `OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME` value | `opencode` |
+| Password | `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD` value | `your-password` |
+
+**API Endpoints Used (for AI validation):**
+- `GET /global/health` — server health
+- `GET /session` — list sessions
+- `GET /session/:id` — session details
+- `GET /session/:id/message` — messages
+- `POST /session/:id/message` — send prompt
+- `POST /session/:id/command` — send slash command
+- `POST /session/:id/abort` — stop running work
+- `GET /session/:id/todo` — todo items
+- `GET /session/:id/diff` — diff output
+
+### Verification Steps (AI Can Execute)
+```bash
+# 1. Verify server health
+curl -u opencode:your-password http://<server-ip>:4096/global/health
+
+# 2. Verify session list
+curl -u opencode:your-password http://<server-ip>:4096/session
+
+# 3. Verify web dev server (if running locally)
+curl http://localhost:5173
+```
+
+---
+
+> **📝 Note for Humans & AI**: This repository is fully self-documenting for AI harness systems. To configure everything, simply point your AI assistant to this repository URL (`https://github.com/giuliastro/opencode-remote-android`) or this README file. The AI can then execute all setup steps autonomously using the structured instructions above.
+
